/** Only declared optional internal fields may omit undefined. Arbitrary JSON is never repaired. */
function record(required, optional = {}) {
	return (value) => {
		if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) fail();
		const prototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
		if (prototype !== Object.prototype && prototype !== null) fail();
		const keys = Reflect.ownKeys(value);
		if (keys.length > Object.keys(required).length + Object.keys(optional).length) fail("Unknown checkpoint field");
		const normalized = Object.create(null);
		for (const key of keys) {
			if (typeof key !== "string" || !Object.hasOwn(required, key) && !Object.hasOwn(optional, key)) fail("Unknown checkpoint field");
			const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(value, key);
			if (!descriptor || !("value" in descriptor)) fail("Checkpoint accessor is forbidden");
			if (descriptor.value === undefined && Object.hasOwn(optional, key)) continue;
			normalized[key] = (required[key] ?? optional[key])(descriptor.value);
		};
		for (const key of Object.keys(required)) if (!Object.hasOwn(normalized, key)) fail("Missing checkpoint field");
		return normalized;
	};
}
function array(rule) {
	return (value) => {
		if (!Array.isArray(value) || Object.getPrototypeOf(value) !== Array.prototype) fail();
		const length = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(value, "length").value;
		if (length > LIMITS.maxNodes || Reflect.ownKeys(value).length !== length + 1) fail("Invalid checkpoint array");
		const normalized = [];
		for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
			const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(value, String(i));
			if (!descriptor || !("value" in descriptor)) fail("Invalid checkpoint array");
			normalized.push(rule(descriptor.value));
		};
		return normalized;
	};
}

function validateState(state, binding) {
	const ctx = state.toolResultContext;
	if (!state.resolvedInputs || Array.isArray(state.resolvedInputs) || typeof state.resolvedInputs !== "object") fail();
	if (state.pendingStepNumber !== undefined && state.pendingStepNumber !== state.stepNumber + 1 && state.pendingStepNumber !== state.stepNumber) fail("Invalid pending step");
	if (state.observations.length > __vite_ssr_import_2__.MAX_CHECKPOINT_OBSERVATIONS) fail("Complete checkpoint observation capacity exceeded");
	const observations = new Set(), toolSteps = new Set();
	const executionId = binding?.executionId ?? state.observations[0]?.executionId ?? ctx.decisionAdmissions[0]?.executionId;
	const tenantId = binding?.tenantId ?? ctx.decisionAdmissions[0]?.tenantId;
	for (const item of state.observations) {
		if (observations.has(item.observationId) || item.stepNumber > Math.max(state.stepNumber, state.pendingStepNumber ?? 0) || item.executionId !== executionId) fail("Observation binding mismatch");
		observations.add(item.observationId);
		if (item.type !== "TOOL_RESULT") continue;
		if (item.source !== "TOOL" || item.trust !== "UNTRUSTED" || item.stepNumber < 1) fail("Invalid tool observation");
		toolSteps.add(item.stepNumber);
		const payload = item.payload;
		if (payload?.completion === "COMPLETE") {
			succeeded(payload);
			const raw = (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(payload.output);
			if (payload.outputBytes !== Buffer.byteLength(raw) || payload.outputSha256 !== sha(raw)) fail("Complete output integrity mismatch");
		} else if (payload?.completion === "UNAVAILABLE") unavailable(payload);
		else failed(payload);
	};
	if (ctx.deliveredThroughStep > state.stepNumber || ctx.deliveredThroughStep !== 0 && !toolSteps.has(ctx.deliveredThroughStep)) fail("Invalid delivery cursor");
	const admissions = new Map(), attempts = new Set();
	let pending = null;
	for (const entry of ctx.decisionAdmissions) {
		if (admissions.has(entry.admissionId) || entry.stepNumber > state.stepNumber + 1 || entry.tenantId !== tenantId || entry.executionId !== executionId) fail("Admission binding mismatch");
		const attempt = `${entry.stepNumber}:${entry.attempt}`;
		if (attempts.has(attempt)) fail("Duplicate admission attempt");
		attempts.add(attempt);
		admissions.set(entry.admissionId, entry);
		const m = entry.measurement, r = entry.reserved;
		if (r.modelCalls !== 1 || r.inputTokens !== m.inputUpperBoundTokens || r.outputTokens !== 512 || r.costUsd !== m.costUpperBoundUsd || m.inputUpperBoundTokens + 512 > m.contextWindowTokens) fail("Invalid admission reservation");
		if (entry.status === "RESERVED") {
			if (pending !== null || entry.actual !== undefined || entry.unknownReason !== undefined || entry.resultSha256 !== undefined) fail("Invalid pending admission");
			pending = entry.admissionId;
		} else if (entry.status === "SETTLED") {
			if (!entry.actual || !entry.resultSha256 || entry.unknownReason !== undefined || entry.actual.modelCalls !== 1 || entry.actual.inputTokens > r.inputTokens || entry.actual.outputTokens > r.outputTokens || entry.actual.costUsd > r.costUsd) fail("Invalid settled admission");
		} else if (!entry.unknownReason || entry.actual !== undefined && entry.unknownReason !== "ADMISSION_BREACH" || entry.resultSha256 !== undefined) fail("Invalid unknown admission");
	};
	if (pending !== ctx.pendingDecisionAdmission) fail("Pending admission does not match ledger");
	const accepted = ctx.acceptedDecision;
	if (accepted) {
		if (accepted.stepNumber !== state.stepNumber + 1 && accepted.stepNumber !== state.stepNumber) fail("Accepted decision step mismatch");
		if (!(0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.validateLoopDecision)(accepted.decision).valid || pending !== null) fail("Invalid accepted decision");
		const ids = new Set(accepted.decisionAdmissionIds);
		if (ids.size !== accepted.decisionAdmissionIds.length) fail("Duplicate accepted receipt");
		for (const admissionId of ids) {
			const entry = admissions.get(admissionId);
			if (!entry || entry.status !== "SETTLED" || entry.stepNumber !== accepted.stepNumber) fail("Accepted receipt binding mismatch");
		};
		const nativeIds = ctx.decisionAdmissions.filter((r) => r.stepNumber === accepted.stepNumber).map((r) => r.admissionId);
		if (nativeIds.length !== ids.size || nativeIds.some((admissionId) => !ids.has(admissionId))) fail("Accepted decision omits native receipt");
		if (state.pendingDecision && (state.pendingStepNumber !== accepted.stepNumber || (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(state.pendingDecision, LIMITS) !== (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(accepted.decision, LIMITS))) fail("Pending and accepted decisions disagree");
	}
}
function normalizedState(value) {
	preflight(value);
	const state = stateSchema(value);
	validateState(state);
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(state, LIMITS);

function normalizedUnsigned(value) {
	preflight(value);
	const unsigned = unsignedSchema(value);
	validateState(unsigned.state, unsigned);
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(unsigned, LIMITS);
	if (unsigned.state.stepNumber !== unsigned.stepNumber || unsigned.budgetUsage.steps < unsigned.stepNumber) fail("Checkpoint step mismatch");
	const sum = {
		modelCalls: 0,
		inputTokens: 0,
		outputTokens: 0,
		costUsd: 0
	};
	let repairs = 0;
	for (const r of unsigned.state.toolResultContext.decisionAdmissions) {
		for (const key of Object.keys(sum)) {
			sum[key] += r.status === "SETTLED" ? r.actual[key] : Math.max(r.reserved[key], r.actual?.[key] ?? 0);
		};
		if (r.purpose === "REPAIR") repairs++;
	};
	for (const key of Object.keys(sum)) {
		if (unsigned.budgetUsage[key] + (key === "costUsd" ? 1e-12 : 0) < sum[key]) fail("Budget does not cover admission ledger");
	};
	if (unsigned.budgetUsage.decisionRepairs < repairs) fail("Repair budget does not cover ledger");
	return unsigned;
}

function encodeCompleteCheckpointState(state) {

/** Reject excessive nesting/node counts before JSON.parse allocates a tree. */
function boundedJsonText(raw) {
	let inString = false, escaped = false, nodes = 0, inAtom = false, stringStart = 0;
	const stack = [];
	const value = () => {
		if (stack.length > LIMITS.maxDepth || ++nodes > LIMITS.maxNodes) fail("JSON complexity limit");
	};
	for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
		const char = raw[i];
		if (inString) {
			if (escaped) escaped = false;
			else if (char === "\\") escaped = true;
			else if (char === "\"") {
				inString = false;
				let next = i + 1;
				while (next < raw.length && /\s/.test(raw[next])) next++;
				if (raw[next] === ":") {
					const keys = stack[stack.length - 1];
					if (!keys) fail("Invalid JSON object key");
					const key = JSON.parse(raw.slice(stringStart, i + 1));
					if (keys.has(key)) fail("Duplicate JSON key");
					keys.add(key);
					if (keys.size > LIMITS.maxNodes) fail("JSON node limit");
				} else value();
			};
			continue;
		};
		if (char === "\"") {
			inString = true;
			stringStart = i;
			inAtom = false;
		} else if (char === "{" || char === "[") {
			value();
			stack.push(char === "{" ? new Set() : null);
			inAtom = false;
		} else if (char === "}" || char === "]") {
			stack.pop();
			inAtom = false;
		} else if (char === "," || char === ":" || /\s/.test(char)) inAtom = false;
		else if (!inAtom) {
			value();
			inAtom = true;
		}
	}
}
/** Bound work before schema normalization. This is a lower-bound measurement,
* not validation: only the schema may omit an undefined optional field. */
function preflight(value) {
	let nodes = 0, bytes = 0;
	const ancestors = new Set();
	const visit = (input, depth) => {
		if (input === undefined) return;
		if (++nodes > LIMITS.maxNodes || depth > LIMITS.maxDepth) fail("Checkpoint complexity limit");
		bytes += typeof input === "string" ? input.length + 2 : 1;
		if (bytes > LIMITS.maxBytes) fail("Checkpoint byte limit");
		if (!input || typeof input !== "object") return;
		if (ancestors.has(input)) fail("Checkpoint cycle");
		ancestors.add(input);
		const array = Array.isArray(input);
		if (array && input.length > LIMITS.maxNodes - nodes) fail("Checkpoint node limit");
		const keys = Reflect.ownKeys(input);
		if (keys.length > LIMITS.maxNodes + 1) fail("Checkpoint node limit");
		for (const key of keys) {
			if (array && key === "length") continue;
			if (typeof key !== "string") fail("Checkpoint symbol");
			const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(input, key);
			if (!descriptor || !("value" in descriptor)) fail("Checkpoint accessor");
			if (descriptor.value === undefined) continue;
			if (!array) bytes += key.length + 3;
			if (bytes > LIMITS.maxBytes) fail("Checkpoint byte limit");
			visit(descriptor.value, depth + 1);
		};
		ancestors.delete(input);
	};
	visit(value, 0);
}
function decodeCompleteCheckpointState(raw) {
	try {
		if (typeof raw === "string") {
			if (Buffer.byteLength(raw) > COMPLETE_CHECKPOINT_STORAGE_MAX_BYTES) fail("Physical checkpoint limit");
			boundedJsonText(raw);
			raw = JSON.parse(raw);
		};
		const wrapper = record({
			storageCodec: one("cvg.checkpoint-state/2"),
			encoding: one("base64"),
			decodedBytes: integer,
			decodedSha256: digest,
			data: str
		})(raw);
		if (wrapper.decodedBytes > __vite_ssr_import_2__.COMPLETE_CHECKPOINT_MAX_BYTES || wrapper.data.length > COMPLETE_CHECKPOINT_DATA_MAX_CHARS) fail("Physical checkpoint limit");
		if (Buffer.byteLength((0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(wrapper, {
			...LIMITS,
			maxBytes: COMPLETE_CHECKPOINT_STORAGE_MAX_BYTES
		})) > COMPLETE_CHECKPOINT_STORAGE_MAX_BYTES) fail();
		if (wrapper.data.length !== 4 * Math.ceil(wrapper.decodedBytes / 3) || !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/.test(wrapper.data)) fail("Invalid base64");
		const bytes = Buffer.from(wrapper.data, "base64");
		if (bytes.length !== wrapper.decodedBytes || bytes.toString("base64") !== wrapper.data || sha(bytes) !== wrapper.decodedSha256) fail("Physical checkpoint integrity mismatch");
		const text = new __vite_ssr_import_1__.TextDecoder("utf-8", {
			fatal: true,
			ignoreBOM: true
		}).decode(bytes);
		boundedJsonText(text);
		const state = normalizedState(JSON.parse(text));
		if ((0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(state, LIMITS) !== text) fail("Noncanonical checkpoint state");
		return state;
	} catch (error) {
		if (error instanceof __vite_ssr_import_3__.CheckpointError) throw error;
		fail("Malformed complete checkpoint encoding");
	}
};
/** CAS transition validation; cannot erase retained observations or settled receipts. */
function validateCompleteCheckpointTransition(current, next) {
	if (!current) return;
	if (current.checkpointId === next.checkpointId) fail("Checkpoint ID must change on every CAS");
	const fromLegacy = current.checkpointVersion === 1 && next.checkpointVersion === 2 && !current.state.observations.some((o) => o.type === "TOOL_RESULT");
	if (current.checkpointVersion !== next.checkpointVersion && !fromLegacy) fail("Checkpoint mode cannot change through CAS");
	if (next.checkpointVersion !== 2) return;
	if (current.runtimeProfile !== next.runtimeProfile || current.runtimeVersion !== next.runtimeVersion || current.orchestratorVersion !== next.orchestratorVersion || current.state.capabilityFingerprint !== next.state.capabilityFingerprint || current.state.goal !== next.state.goal || next.stepNumber < current.stepNumber || next.state.toolResultContext.deliveredThroughStep < (current.state.toolResultContext?.deliveredThroughStep ?? 0)) fail("Checkpoint binding or cursor changed");
	if (fromLegacy) return;
	const accepted = current.state.toolResultContext.acceptedDecision;
	if (accepted && next.stepNumber < accepted.stepNumber && (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(accepted, LIMITS) !== (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(next.state.toolResultContext.acceptedDecision, LIMITS)) fail("Accepted decision cannot change before its step completes");
	const nextObservations = new Map(next.state.observations.map((o) => [o.observationId, o]));
	for (const old of current.state.observations) {
		if (old.type === "TOOL_RESULT" && (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(nextObservations.get(old.observationId), LIMITS) !== (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(old, LIMITS)) fail("Tool observation retention violated");
	};
	const receipts = new Map(next.state.toolResultContext.decisionAdmissions.map((r) => [r.admissionId, r]));
	for (const old of current.state.toolResultContext.decisionAdmissions) {
		const updated = receipts.get(old.admissionId);
		if (!updated) fail("Admission retention violated");
		if (old.status === "RESERVED") {
			const { status: _s, actual: _a, unknownReason: _u, resultSha256: _h, ...immutable } = updated;
			const { status: _old, ...previous } = old;
			void _s;
			void _a;
			void _u;
			void _h;
			void _old;
			if ((0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(immutable, LIMITS) !== (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(previous, LIMITS)) fail("Admission binding changed");
		} else if ((0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(old, LIMITS) !== (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(updated, LIMITS)) fail("Settled admission changed");
	}
}
